items.docs: Retrieves the full public-safe content of a saved agent conversation: ordered turns (user messages and agent response items) and sanitized code-execution file metadata. Internal graph or branch state, Azure file identifiers, and messages with a `SYSTEM` source are omitted. The full answer payload is not embedded; fetch it separately via `loadAnswer` using the `answer_id` on each `answer` response item. Requires `CAN_USE_SPOTTER` privilege and access to the specified conversation.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of conversations to return. Used for pagination.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of conversations to skip before returning results. Used for pagination.

params.name: skip_empty
params.description: When true, excludes conversations with no messages. Defaults to true.
